subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should visible pre-processing text be a shared messages configuration contract or a plugin-owned channel capability built on a common lifecycle API?
rationale: Reactions have reasonably uniform shared semantics, while visible text placeholders affect channel-specific threading, editing, deletion, failure handling, transcripts, and `NO_REPLY`; repository evidence cannot determine the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Typed plugin lifecycle
options.body: Add a shared lifecycle/capability seam and keep text configuration plus transport-specific send, edit, delete, threading, and cleanup behavior in each channel plugin.

options.title: Global ack text
options.body: Add `messages.ackText` and shared scope resolution, requiring supported plugins to implement an equivalent cross-channel contract.

options.title: Separate channel features
options.body: Let each channel add independent placeholder settings without creating a shared lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Typed plugin lifecycle
recommendation.body: Add a shared lifecycle/capability seam and keep text configuration plus transport-specific send, edit, delete, threading, and cleanup behavior in each channel plugin.

likelyOwner.reason: His recent merged work spans the shared dispatch lifecycle, source reply delivery, typing, and acknowledgement cleanup central to this product/API choice.
